tips_en: Start with ZGCM-1 (Paper 2), as its core thesis—that compact 7B models can rival frontier systems through internal reasoning plus external tool use—is both counterintuitive and broadly influential. This connects directly to RSIAgent (Paper 3), which shows a similar 'small model + smart external mechanism' philosophy by letting open-source agents beat GPT-6 and Claude Opus 5 through structured exploration without parameter updates. Vidu S2 (Paper 1) rounds out the trio with a complementary engineering story: its VLM agentic system for real-time video control demonstrates how agent-style control loops are reshaping generative media.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 ZGCM-1（论文2），其核心论点——7B 紧凑模型可通过内部推理与外部工具使用相结合来比肩前沿系统——既出人意料又影响广泛。这一思路与 RSIAgent（论文3）高度呼应：后者同样秉持'小模型+智能外部机制'的理念，让开源智能体无需更新参数即可超越 GPT-6 和 Claude Opus 5。Vidu S2（论文1）则以其实时视频控制的 VLM 智能体系统，与前两篇构成互补，展现了智能体式控制回路正在重塑生成式媒体的技术方向。
